$sources: IS 3370 (Part 1):2009 and IS 3370 (Part 2):2009, concrete structures for the storage of liquids: the RC water tanks' design (alpha 9 track C12); the building services' values stay the default pack's

sources.tanks.cover: IS 3370 (Part 1):2009 8.2: nominal cover at least 45 mm on the faces in contact with the liquid and those exposed to the weather (severe, M30 at least: Table 1), IS 456 Table 16 moderate 30 mm on the faces against non-aggressive soil
sources.tanks.againstEarth: SAEngine practice: 75 mm cast against the earth, the default pack's value kept (IS 456 26.4.2.2 asks 50 mm for footings)
sources.tanks.maxSpacing: IS 3370 (Part 2):2009 8.2 with IS 456 26.3.3: bars at most 3h and 300 mm apart
sources.tanks.maxWaterCement: IS 3370 (Part 1):2009 Table 1: w/c at most 0.45 for RC (M30, 320 kg/m³ cement at least)
sources.tanks.combinations: IS 456:2000 Table 18 (γf 1.5, 0.9 for the dead load against the earth) with the liquid as an imposed load (IS 3370 (Part 2):2009 4.2), service by IS 3370 (Part 2) 4.1 at γf 1.0
sources.tanks.crackLimit: IS 3370 (Part 2):2009 4.1.1 / 4.2: limit state of cracking, surface crack width at most 0.2 mm (0.1 mm for severe exposure or aesthetics: set it under Code Values)
sources.tanks.steelStress: IS 3370 (Part 2):2009 Table 2 (working stress method, crackControl steelStress): HYSD bars 130 MPa in direct tension and in flexure on the liquid face, 190 MPa on faces away from the liquid
sources.tanks.surfaceZone: IS 3370 (Part 2):2009 8.1.1: least steel 0.35 % (HYSD) of the surface zone in each direction at each face, the surface zone half the thickness up to 250 mm (SAEngine reading of Figure 1)
sources.tanks.uplift: IS 3370 (Part 1):2009 and IS 456 20.1: uplift by the full hydrostatic pressure under the base, flotation by IS 456 20.1 (0.9 D)
